# transcats

The goal of transcats is to **trans**late the variable names and titles
and values of dataframes containing containing **cat**egorical and other
data. These translations are made using editable translation tables to
allow users to edit and verify translations.

## Installation

You can install the development version of transcats from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("CarwilB/transcats")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(transcats)
## basic example code
names(forcats::gss_cat)
#> [1] "year"    "marital" "age"     "race"    "rincome" "partyid" "relig"  
#> [8] "denom"   "tvhours"
```

``` r

set_title_lang("es")
set_var_name_table(gss_var_table)
variable_names_vector(forcats::gss_cat)
#> [1] "año de la encuesta"              "estado civil"                   
#> [3] "edad"                            "raza"                           
#> [5] "ingresos declarados"             "afiliación partidaria"          
#> [7] "religión"                        "denominación"                   
#> [9] "horas diarias viendo televisión"
```

## Translating tabular data

There’s a longer workflow for translating categorical data (see the
vignette “A workflow for creating translation tables”), but the net
result is full translation of categorical data.

| year | marital | age | race | rincome | partyid | relig | denom | tvhours |
|---:|:---|---:|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|---:|
| 2000 | Never married | 26 | White | \$8000 to 9999 | Ind,near rep | Protestant | Southern baptist | 12 |
| 2000 | Divorced | 48 | White | \$8000 to 9999 | Not str republican | Protestant | Baptist-dk which | NA |
| 2000 | Widowed | 67 | White | Not applicable | Independent | Protestant | No denomination | 2 |
| 2000 | Never married | 39 | White | Not applicable | Ind,near rep | Orthodox-christian | Not applicable | 4 |
| 2000 | Divorced | 25 | White | Not applicable | Not str democrat | None | Not applicable | 1 |
| 2000 | Married | 25 | White | \$20000 - 24999 | Strong democrat | Protestant | Southern baptist | NA |
| 2000 | Never married | 36 | White | \$25000 or more | Not str republican | Christian | Not applicable | 3 |
| 2000 | Divorced | 44 | White | \$7000 to 7999 | Ind,near dem | Protestant | Lutheran-mo synod | NA |

| year | marital_fr | age | race_fr | rincome_fr | partyid_fr | relig_fr | denom_fr | tvhours |
|---:|:---|---:|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|---:|
| 2000 | Jamais marié.e | 26 | Blanc.he | \$8000 à 9999 | Indépendant.e, proche du républicain.e | Protestant | Baptiste du Sud | 12 |
| 2000 | Divorcé.e | 48 | Blanc.he | \$8000 à 9999 | Républicain.e, pas fort.e | Protestant | Baptiste, ne sait pas lequel | NA |
| 2000 | Veuf/Veuve | 67 | Blanc.he | Non applicable | Indépendant.e | Protestant | Aucune dénomination | 2 |
| 2000 | Jamais marié.e | 39 | Blanc.he | Non applicable | Indépendant.e, proche du républicain.e | Chrétien orthodoxe | Sans objet | 4 |
| 2000 | Divorcé.e | 25 | Blanc.he | Non applicable | Démocrate, pas fort.e | Aucune religion | Sans objet | 1 |
| 2000 | Marié.e | 25 | Blanc.he | \$20000 à 24999 | Démocrate fort.e | Protestant | Baptiste du Sud | NA |
| 2000 | Jamais marié.e | 36 | Blanc.he | \$25000 ou plus | Républicain.e, pas fort.e | Chrétien | Sans objet | 3 |
| 2000 | Divorcé.e | 44 | Blanc.he | \$7000 à 7999 | Indépendant.e, proche du démocrate | Protestant | Synode luthérien-Missouri | NA |

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_translated_levels()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/add_translated_levels.md)
  : Add translated levels to a list object
- [`append_to_var_name_table()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/append_to_var_name_table.md)
  : Append new entries to variable_name_table
- [`create_blank_translation_table()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/create_blank_translation_table.md)
  : Create one blank translation table
- [`create_blank_translation_tables()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/create_blank_translation_tables.md)
  : Create a composite translation table
- [`dest_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/dest_lang.md)
  : Report the active destination language for translation
- [`dest_lang_list()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/dest_lang_list.md)
  : Report the active destination language list for translation
- [`get_translation_variables()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/get_translation_variables.md)
  : Get list of variables in the active translation table
- [`gss_translation`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/gss_translation.md)
  : Translation table for gss_cat
- [`gss_var_table`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/gss_var_table.md)
  : Variable name table for gss_cat
- [`parse_combined_translation_table()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/parse_combined_translation_table.md)
  : Reformat a combined translation table into a standard one
- [`reactable_lang_en()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/reactable_lang_en.md)
  : Provide English-language text for interactive Reactable interface
  elements
- [`reactable_lang_es()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/reactable_lang_es.md)
  : Provide Spanish-language text for interactive Reactable interface
  elements
- [`set_active_translation_table()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/set_active_translation_table.md)
  : Change the active translation table
- [`set_dest_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/set_dest_lang.md)
  : Change the active destination language for translation
- [`set_dest_lang_list()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/set_dest_lang_list.md)
  : Change the active destination language list for multiple
  translations
- [`set_source_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/set_source_lang.md)
  : Change the active source language for translation
- [`set_title_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/set_title_lang.md)
  : Change the active language for names of variables
- [`set_var_name_table()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/set_var_name_table.md)
  : Change the active variable name table
- [`source_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/source_lang.md)
  : Report the active source language for translation
- [`sr_levels`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/sr_levels.md)
  : State Responsibility Levels
- [`title_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/title_lang.md)
  : Report the active language for names of variables
- [`translated_join()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translated_join.md)
  [`translated_join_vars()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translated_join.md)
  : Translated Join
- [`translated_levels()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translated_levels.md)
  : Translated levels
- [`translation_available_for()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translation_available_for.md)
  [`num_translation_available()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translation_available_for.md)
  [`all_translation_available_for()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translation_available_for.md)
  [`which_translation_unavailable_for()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/translation_available_for.md)
  : Check whether translations are available for all values in a
  vector/column
- [`uc_translation`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/uc_translation.md)
  : Ultimate Consequences Translation Table
- [`uc_var_table`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/uc_var_table.md)
  [`n_trans_table`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/uc_var_table.md)
  [`uc_var_table_ext`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/uc_var_table.md)
  [`uc_translation_tables_2025_aug`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/uc_var_table.md)
  : Ultimate Consequences Variable Name Translation Tables
- [`var_lang()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/var_lang.md)
  : Language-specific names for variables (shortened call)
- [`var_lang_str()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/var_lang_str.md)
  : Language-specific names for variables (shortened call)
- [`var_name_language_available()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/var_name_language_available.md)
  : Check if a language is available in a variable name table
- [`variable_name()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/variable_name.md)
  : Language-specific names for variables
- [`variable_name_from_string()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/variable_name_from_string.md)
  : Language-specific names for variables
- [`variable_names_vector()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/variable_names_vector.md)
  : Produce a list of display names for each variables
- [`which_translation_available()`](https://carwilb.github.io/transcats/reference/which_translation_available.md)
  : Show values with available translations
